title: 〜そばから
meaning: as soon as … (it is undone again); no sooner … than …
simpleExplanation: Vるそばから / Vたそばから describes a frustrating cycle: as soon as A happens, B immediately cancels it out, and this keeps repeating. 片付けるそばから散らかす "as soon as I tidy up, they mess it up again". The key nuance is repetition and futility.
whenUsed: Both registers; common in complaints about children, memory, or work. Not for a single dramatic event.
formation: A そばから B: B undoes A, repeatedly

rows.label: 〜そばから

rows.label: 〜なり

examples.ja: 片付けるそばから、子供が散らかしていく。
examples.reading: かたづけるそばから、こどもがちらかしていく。
examples.en: As soon as I tidy up, the kids mess it up again.
examples.note: Tidying is undone by the children again and again.

examples.ja: 覚えたそばから忘れてしまう。
examples.reading: おぼえたそばからわすれてしまう。
examples.en: I forget things right after I memorize them.

examples.ja: 注意したそばから、また同じミスをする。
examples.reading: ちゅういしたそばから、またおなじミスをする。
examples.en: Right after being warned, he makes the same mistake again.
examples.note: Warning is undone by the same mistake; note the general present tense.

examples.ja: お金は入ってくるそばから出ていってしまう。
examples.reading: おかねははいってくるそばからでていってしまう。
examples.en: Money goes out as fast as it comes in.

examples.ja: 書類を処理したそばから、新しい依頼が届く。
examples.reading: しょるいをしょりしたそばから、あたらしいいらいがとどく。
examples.en: No sooner have I dealt with one document than a new request arrives.

similarGrammar.difference: One-off "the instant that"; no sense of repetition or undoing.
One-off, emphasises speed of the second action.
One-off, past, same subject, unexpected next action.

commonMistakes.wrong: 駅に着いたそばから電話が鳴った。
commonMistakes.right: 駅に着くや否や電話が鳴った。
commonMistakes.why: A single event with no repetition takes や否や / たとたん; そばから implies a repeated cycle.

commonMistakes.wrong: そばから覚えるそばから忘れる。
commonMistakes.right: 覚えるそばから忘れる。
commonMistakes.why: そばから goes only after the first verb.

commonMistakes.wrong: 彼は宿題をするそばから褒められる。
commonMistakes.right: 彼は宿題をするそばから遊びに行ってしまう。
commonMistakes.why: The second clause must undo or frustrate the first; a positive result does not fit.

usageNotes: Typical pairs: 片付ける→散らかす, 覚える→忘れる, 洗う→汚す, 稼ぐ→使う, 注意する→繰り返す.
The tense is usually general (present) because the cycle repeats.
Often has an exasperated tone; fits complaints.
jlptTips: Look for a verb pair where the second undoes the first and a sense of repetition; that is そばから, not や否や.
If the sentence is a single past event with a surprising follow-up, choose なり or や否や instead.
Both Vる and Vた are accepted before そばから; do not reject an option for the tense alone.
